name: TestStub
summary: Feeds the system under test the indirect inputs a test needs, so that logic depending on what another component returns can be verified.

roles.name: TestStub
roles.summary: A double that answers with what the test decided it should answer. Its whole direction is inward — it supplies inputs and it is not consulted afterwards, so a stub that has grown assertions is a mock wearing the wrong name, which is the confusion this catalogue exists to end.
